headline: FY26 revenue of Rs 413.97 cr (+63% on the DRHP's proforma FY25) and PAT of Rs 31.39 cr come from a business that was bought from the promoters' proprietorships only on 01-Apr-2025, so the three-year series mixes bases; what decides the issue is whether the FY26 step-up, 25% of it from one customer and 93.99% from Northern and Central states, repeats in the RHP.
red_flags: Proforma revenue Rs 2,537.60 m to Rs 4,139.70 m (+63%) and PAT Rs 206.95 m to Rs 313.90 m (+52%) in FY26; 19,111 units vs 12,234
Current tax 26.1% of cumulative PBT; FY26 EBITDA margin 13.46% vs 14.51% proforma FY25
FY26 CFO Rs 26.85 m vs PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%); cumulative FY24-26 CFO/PAT 69.7%
Top customer Seth Agro Industries 25.21% of FY26 revenue; Northern and Central states 93.99%
Promoter links: Both plants and the Dehlon expansion are on promoter-leased land; Rs 55.00 m lent to promoters; business bought from promoter firms
Offer under Reg 6(2): 75% to QIBs; promoter sells 31.00 lakh shares (OFS); Rs 716.64 m capex with no orders placed
reference_note: Rs 131.69 = lowest listed-peer P/E in the DRHP (Escorts Kubota 23.35x, p. 156) x FY26 EPS Rs 5.64. An illustrative reference, not a price band; no band exists. The only transaction price in the DRHP is Rs 1,547 per pre-bonus Rs 10 share (about Rs 33.63 per Rs 5 share after the 22:1 bonus and split), used for the promoter business purchase in 2025 (p. 388).

strengths: Proforma revenue +63% in FY26 to Rs 4,139.70 m; units 19,111 vs 12,234 (pp. 90, 158)
Current tax 26.1% of cumulative PBT; profit taxed in cash (p. 87)
Third-largest homegrown implement maker per the issuer-commissioned CARE report; about 13% of straw reapers (p. 245)
Receivables 97% within six months of due date (p. 371)
weaknesses: Mixed series: FY26 consolidated, FY25 and FY24 standalone (p. 87)
FY26 CFO Rs 26.85 m vs PAT Rs 313.90 m; inventory up Rs 445.46 m (p. 88)
Top customer 25.21% and top-10 50.04% of revenue (p. 36)
Northern and Central states 93.99% of revenue (p. 246)
opportunities: Farm-equipment market projected at 7.7% CAGR FY26-30 (issuer-commissioned report, p. 129)
Dehlon expansion: Rs 716.64 m for a stated capacity of 4,000 to 33,000 (unit label unclear) (p. 133)
Super Seeder share of 30% in Madhya Pradesh, 15% Haryana, 12% Punjab (p. 245)
Biomass briquette and pellet machinery for crop residue (p. 245)
threats: Demand tied to CRM and SMAM subsidy schemes, 60:40 Centre-State (p. 56)
No long-term supply or customer agreements (p. 23)
Working capital: borrowings Rs 1,344.07 m, current ratio 1.10 (p. 158)
Past director disqualification and RoC filing delays (p. 24)

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -52.9% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess
model.reverse_dcf: Current free cash flow is negative: no multiple can be stated, and the entire price rests on a turn that has not yet begun.
